title: Rapunzel’s Tower
description: A Tangled-inspired tower, sculpted with intricate details and painted to give precise control over the colors.
images: Rapunzel-inspired tower · Painted sculpture and process

title: A Wonderland of Hats
description: A towering sculpture inspired by the characters of Alice in Wonderland. Individual ceramic hats slide onto a wooden support to create a playful balancing act.
images: Wonderland hats · Concept, process, and assembled sculpture

title: Fantasy Dragon
description: A dragon sculpture with separately constructed wings that slot into the body. Contrasting glaze finishes give the blue surfaces a matte appearance and the black details a shine.
images: Fantasy dragon · Sculptural details and process

title: Sleeping Beauty
description: An open book with vines supporting a spinning wheel, the Sword of Truth, and the Shield of Virtue, inspired by Sleeping Beauty.

title: Comedy & Tragedy
description: Theater masks inspired by classical depictions of comedy and drama. Green and copper glazes suggest oxidation and an aged surface.

title: An Enchanted Tea Set
description: A functional tea set inspired by Mrs. Potts, Chip, and the character designs of the 1991 Beauty and the Beast, bringing storytelling to everyday objects.
images: Beauty and the Beast-inspired ceramic tea set

title: A Little Forest
description: Red-and-white mushrooms evoke folklore and fantasy, while an irregular base follows the organic shapes of nature.
